fields.Fees — Published: Dedicated official PGDM fee: ₹6.25 lakh (₹3.60 lakh + ₹2.65 lakh). The official 2026 management landing page instead quotes ₹6 lakh (₹3.60 lakh + ₹2.40 lakh). Obtain a signed offer to resolve.
fields.Fee Scope: Two-year published PGDM reference ₹6.25 lakh; conflicting 2026 landing quote ₹6 lakh. Living charges excluded.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, MAT, XAT, ATMA, CMAT or GMAT
fields.Eligibility: UGC-recognised 10+2+3 bachelor’s degree with 50%, or 45% for reserved categories. Final-year applicants must complete examination formalities by October 2026.
fields.Selection Process: Merit considers academic record, experience and entrance scores; written communication test, case study, GD and personal interview. General admission page also mentions psychological/aptitude testing; no numerical weights stated.
